title: Polish the complete night experience
summary: A complete presentation pass makes every operational screen feel calmer, clearer and more consistent while preserving the existing roster, break and clock-change logic.
changes: Unifies typography, spacing, surface depth and colour hierarchy across Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat, Full Roster and Personalise.
Makes Changes decision-first by keeping the Staffing → Allocation → Confirm workflow prominent while moving secondary explanations behind calm on-demand disclosure.
Improves Full Roster scanning with role-aware grouping and increases the readability of secondary labels, statuses and supporting information across the app.
Refines the shared shift identity, collapsed scroll chrome, bottom navigation, chat bubbles, break schedule and Personalisation Studio with restrained motion and accessibility fallbacks.
